orb.name: Opening Range Breakout
orb.desc: After 9:30, trade the first close beyond the 15-min opening range, only on the VWAP side and with volume >= 1.2x average. Stop: other side of the range (max 2 ATR). Target 2R. Exit early if price closes back through VWAP. One long and one short a day.

pullback.name: VWAP-EMA Pullback
pullback.desc: Trend day continuation: EMA9 above EMA21, price above VWAP, Supertrend up, then a candle dips to EMA9 and closes green above it with RSI 50-70 (mirror for shorts). Stop below the candle low. Target 2R. Exit if price closes beyond EMA21. One trade a day.

supertrend.name: Supertrend + VWAP
supertrend.desc: Enter within 3 candles of a Supertrend(10,3) flip, once per leg, only if price is on the same side of VWAP and EMA9/EMA21 agree. Stop at the Supertrend line. Target 2R. Exit on the opposite flip.
